name: ck_ai_conversation_items_content
expression: (message_type = 'text' AND text_content IS NOT NULL AND media_url IS NULL) OR (message_type IN ('image','audio') AND media_url IS NOT NULL)

name: ck_ai_conversation_items_user_buffer
expression: (role = 'user' AND buffer_id IS NOT NULL) OR (role <> 'user')

name: idx_ai_conv_items_buffer
expression: ai_conversation_items.buffer_id WHERE buffer_id IS NOT NULL

name: idx_ai_instance_memories_source
expression: ai_instance_memories.source_message_id WHERE source_message_id IS NOT NULL

name: idx_ai_instances_persona_id
expression: ai_instances.persona_id WHERE persona_id IS NOT NULL

name: idx_ai_message_buffer_expire_scan
expression: ai_message_buffer.user_qiao_id,ai_message_buffer.instance_qiao_id,ai_message_buffer.buffer_expires_at_ms WHERE aggregate_state IN (0, 1) AND buffer_expires_at_ms IS NOT NULL

name: ck_message_endpoints_scope_device
expression: (endpoint_scope = 1 AND device_id IS NULL) OR (endpoint_scope = 2 AND device_id IS NOT NULL)

name: ck_message_history_inbound_provider
expression: inbound_provider IS NULL OR inbound_provider IN (1, 2)

name: idx_user_tokens_refresh_hash
expression: user_tokens.refresh_token_hash WHERE refresh_token_hash IS NOT NULL
